response.justification: The candidate's resume shows extensive experience in software development, web technologies, and some embedded systems, but lacks direct experience with AI accelerators, deep learning workloads, SoC/IP modeling, or hardware-software co-design. While the candidate has a strong background in performance optimization (e.g., low-latency apps, real-time systems), it is focused on general software systems rather than AI hardware or cloud infrastructure. The educational background (Bachelor's in Computer Science) does not meet the preferred advanced degrees, and there is no evidence of work with SIMD/MIMD architectures, GPU optimization, or export-control compliance requirements.
strengths: Extensive software development experience across multiple languages and domains
Demonstrated ability to optimize performance in low-latency systems
Proven track record of system design and architecture in various contexts
concerns: No direct experience with AI accelerators, SoC/IP modeling, or hardware-software co-design
Lacks preferred advanced degree (PhD/Master's) for Principal-level role
No evidence of work with GPU architecture, deep neural network optimization, or SIMD/MIMD architectures
